headline: Sotuver: a block at 23,58 dinars, +81% on the price of BA Glass
summary: A block of 1,060,000 shares of Société tunisienne de verreries changed hands on 9 November 2026 at 23.58 dinars per share. The price was reported as up 81 percent.
why: BA Glass is a Tunisian glass-packaging producer, and large block trades can signal shifts in shareholder positions on the local exchange.
